call_points.text: Net worth rose to ₹1,136 Cr from ₹650 Cr in March 2026 following the rights issue.
Average funding book stands at ₹480 Cr, diversified across a large number of clients.
Trendlyne acquisition approved in July; formal closing and legal structure (merger vs subsidiary) pending.
Mutual fund assets on the platform reached ₹2,095 Cr.
Derivatives volume dropped following the cash rollout; market trading activity was slower across the board.
95% of new customers this quarter joined via DIY digital onboarding.
Management expects growth to accelerate from Q2FY27, viewing Q1 moderation as one-off due to market volatility.
₹468 Cr rights issue proceeds deployed: ₹227 Cr for exchange margins, ₹150 Cr for debt repayment, ₹88 Cr for product/tech/marketing.
Focus on quality customer acquisition with higher RPC and LTV, rather than just customer numbers.
Goal is to improve unit economics and achieve operating leverage as the platform scales.
Market volatility and moderation in overall trading volumes remain headwinds.

operating_notes.text: The company undertook a rights issue of 1,56,27,419 equity shares at ₹300 per share aggregating to ₹468.82 crore.
The company onboarded 1.03 lakh new clients during Q4FY26, taking the total registered customer base to 51.8 lakh.
The company received an income tax demand order of ₹33.03 crore under Section 158BC(1)(c) of the Income Tax Act, 1961.
The company acquired over 1 lakh customers in Q4FY26, taking total customer base to 51.8 lakh.
Received SEBI show cause notice under Section 12(3) of SEBI Act regarding Investment Adviser registration expiry and fee payment.
Rights issue proceeds of ₹468 Cr deployed: ₹227 Cr for exchange margins, ₹150 Cr for debt repayment, ₹88 Cr for product/tech/marketing.
Focus on quality customer acquisition with higher RPC and LTV, rather than just customer numbers.
Platform revamp and AI integration (AlgoSpace, AI insights) are key strategic initiatives to drive user engagement and monetization.
Established 5paisa Capital Limited (IFSC Branch) at GIFT City, Gujarat.
95% of new customers joined via DIY digital onboarding.
Capitalized ₹6.2 Cr of technology costs for app rebuilding.

timeline.summary: 5Paisa Capital received an income tax assessment order demanding ₹33.03 crore under Section 158BC of the Income Tax Act.
5Paisa Capital reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹85.5 crore, up 8% QoQ, and completed a ₹468 crore rights issue.
On 05 June 2026, 5Paisa Capital received a SEBI show cause notice regarding the potential cancellation or suspension of its Investment Adviser registration for non-payment of fees.
5Paisa Capital held Q1FY27 earnings conference call on 17 July 2026, reporting 14% YoY revenue growth to ₹88.4 Cr and 18% QoQ growth in mutual fund AUM to ₹2,073 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹86.42 Cr (+11.8% YoY), net profit ₹7.06 Cr (-25.5% YoY).
5paisa Capital reported a tech-led transition in Q2FY27, capitalizing ₹6.2 Cr in app development costs while its net worth reached ₹1,136 Cr post-rights issue.
